attributes.board_name: Colorado State Board of Psychologist Examiners (Division of Professions and Occupations)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Coursework approved/accredited by APA, a state medical association, ACCME or a regionally accredited college (except 5 PDH), in person or online; ethics courses; teaching a new academic course; graduate coursework; presenting (1 h = 3 PDH); publications; editorial review
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed during a license period: 1.67 PDH per month from the month of issue through the month the license expires.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 PDH above 40 may carry over if earned within the last three months before license expiration.
rules.audit_note: Audits after each renewal cycle; keep Learning Plan and documentation at least five years; do not submit unless requested.
rules.notes: Continuing Professional Development program: optional self-assessment, Learning Plan, 40 PDH (1 PDH = 60 min). Holders of 2-3 DORA mental-health licenses need only 40 PDH in total. The CPD Manual shows the period Sept 1, 2023 - Aug 31, 2025.
rules.rule_quote: Execution of the Learning Plan - accrual of 40 Professional Development Hours (PDH) through the Professional Development Activities (PDA) is required.
